title: A thousand hours
style: handheld documentary footage, available light, close on hands and objects

lines.vo: In nineteen twenty four the men who made light bulbs agreed to make them worse.
lines.footage: glowing light bulb filament close up

lines.vo: Meeting in Geneva, they capped every bulb at a thousand hours.
lines.footage: hands signing a paper document close up
lines.alt: old typewriter typing document close up

lines.vo: Any factory whose bulbs lasted longer was fined by the others.
lines.alt: glass bottles moving on a conveyor belt

lines.vo: Average life fell by half in eight years. Sales rose.
lines.footage: hands unscrewing a light bulb from a ceiling fixture
lines.alt: changing a light bulb close up

lines.vo: The cartel broke up in the war. The habit did not.
lines.footage: broken electronics in a pile close up

lines.vo: One bulb from nineteen oh one still burns in a California firehouse.
lines.footage: single light bulb glowing in a dark room
lines.alt: dusty bulb hanging from ceiling dark
